settings.title: Ring Size Guide
settings.subtitle:
Getting the right ring size is one of the most important steps in ordering fine jewelry — and we've made it as easy as possible.

Whether you're measuring for yourself, trying to find the size of a loved one before a surprise proposal, or need a resize after delivery, this guide covers everything you need. And if your ring doesn't fit perfectly when it arrives, we'll resize it free of charge within 90 days — including shipping both ways.

settings.link_text: find the ring size of a loved one

settings.text: Specially designed just for you! You can custom design any type of jewelry: rings, bracelets, necklaces, or earrings. We don't charge extra for the design services, including sketches or CAD designs. Our custom design process requires a $1,000 minimum order, and we require a $100 deposit to get the design started which will be applied to the final price of your purchase. Returns are accepted for your custom jewelry within our return policy, but custom pieces may be returned for store credit only.

At MiaDonna, we want your ring to fit perfectly! If the sizing is a little off, we're here to help. We are happy to offer full-service support for any adjustments needed after your purchase.

Complimentary Resizing: We offer one free resizing for up to one full ring size (either up or down) within the first 90 days of shipment, including free shipping. Please note that eternity bands cannot be re-sized, but we will re-make eternity bands in the new size one time at no cost to you.

Post-90 Day/Larger Resizes: Resizing that falls outside of the 90-day window, or for adjustments of more than one full size, will be charged at our standard rates: $100 for 14k/18k and $120 for platinum. Shipping is free within the first 90 days of your original shipment. Please note that we cannot re-size eternity rings after the first 90 days of your original shipment.

Integrity is Key: It’s important to know the exact size you need, as sizing adjustments of more than half a size may require our jewelers to first evaluate the design to maintain the ring's integrity.

Ready to send your ring in? Just Contact Us to set up the service! Once we receive your ring, the process takes approximately 1-2 weeks, including return shipping via FedEx 2-Day service.

settings.title2: FIND THE RING SIZE OF A LOVED ONE
settings.text:
Planning a surprise is thrilling, and we can help you keep the secret while getting the size right! Since most engagements are a surprise, here are a few of our favorite discreet suggestions:

Borrow and Trace: Borrow one of your partner's rings (from the correct finger!) and use our Printable Ring Sizer to determine the size.

Make an Impression: If they tend to leave a ring lying around, gently press it into a bar of soap, a piece of clay, or even bread to get a reliable impression for measurement.

Trace the Inside: Trace the inner circle of an existing ring onto a piece of paper. This tracing can be used for a measurement.

Enlist a Trusted Friend: Talk to one of your partner's "secret-keeping" friends. It's an easy and common inquiry for a friend to ask their ring size out of curiosity.

Remember, even if you're a little off, our Resizing Policy means you can still propose with absolute confidence!

Finding your precise size is the first step to a perfect fit! We craft each ring just for you, so taking a moment to measure accurately makes all the difference. While being sized by a professional jeweler is the most accurate method, we have two excellent tools to help you find the correct size.

Our Helpful Sizing Tools

Purchase a Plastic Ring Sizer: Get our comprehensive plastic ring sizer, featuring 27 individual plastic rings from US size 0 through size 13 in half-size increments. It's available with free shipping in the continental US.

Download Our Printable Sizing Chart: You can use our printable ring sizer PDF right at home! Just be sure to set the page scaling to "none" in your print settings for an accurate measurement.

International Customers: If you are an international customer, you can download our handy International Ring Size Conversion Chart to find your equivalent size.

settings.title2: MEASURING TIPS FOR THE BEST FIT
settings.text:
Download: Utilize our printable ring sizer PDF to get your ring measurement. Remember to set the page scaling to "none" in your print settings for an accurate measurement.

Measure Warm: Don't measure cold fingers, as this is when they are their smallest!

Measure Late: The most accurate reading is often taken at the end of the day when your finger is largest.

Go Snug: The sizer should fit snugly – tight enough that it requires a gentle pull to remove, which is how a well-fitting ring should feel.

Check the Width: Remember to consider the width of the band you are purchasing, as this can affect the size you need.
